the beam crosses the NopeAI boardroom's window (on an eighth, 0.23 s before the cut): the eighths and the 808 move to F; the Lighthouse cell stays behind

the TV: Neleh's voice through the podcast player (on an eighth, 0.35 s before the cut): the quartet thins to its pedal (F2 + C3, sul tasto; no eighths, no 808); a high violin harmonic (C6, her colour) enters softly before her first word; her words and the board's card play dry
his face holds still (2 s), after the card's read: the harmonic rises a semitone (C6 to D-flat 6: Neleh's question colour, OST §2.16): the held breath
Terb clicks the TV off: the harmonic goes with it; the pedal holds under "First item."
the split (on an eighth, 0.40 s before the cut): LEVERAGE back: the eighths, the 808, the violins' close dyad (C5 + D-flat 5, sul tasto)
the lanyards drop in both panes on one beat (lanyard_drop 33.942): the rhyme on one action; an 808 thud on that beat (the 808's, not a hit on the lanyard)
"present.": THE 808 DROPS OUT (its last thud 49.271; the stop is the move, P03); the quartet carries on alone
after "present.": the violins' dyad a semitone up (D-flat + D: the leverage moved)
after "also present.": the dyad a semitone up again (D + E-flat); Mada's second word; the table holds its breath; V.O. 11 inside the bed (the eighths softer, nothing attacks on the words)

RIGHT: Mario's pane (on the beat, 0.21 s before the cut): B-flat minor; Mario's Addendum (B-flat C D-flat F | E-flat D-flat C B-flat) in the viola's pizzicato, the cello's off-beats, a soft arco bass on B-flat; the Lighthouse cell (marimba, harp) beside it; the chip a triangle bass only (OST §2.8)
the Addendum, statement 1: the head and a one-bar tail (C D-flat, then a rest)
the highlighted line (Ekiel's own, [V]): the Addendum rests; the cell and the bass hold (the record dry)
statement 2: it gains a bar (the tail climbs C D-flat E-flat F, then G-flat; never cadences)
statement 3: it gains another bar...
...and is cut off before "It's that we might win." (89.18): the stop; the dry chill: the Ache (glass G4 + D-flat 5) over an F pedal, under the line
LEFT: his phone lights with the reminder (ELPPA · KEYNOTE · JUN 10): the F eighths again, softly; the keynote's walk-on bed comes up under them (J 0.8 s, E02-11b)

the lobby (on the beat, 0.42 s before the cut): the quartet alone (no 808) on the deal day's A-flat cycle (A-flat maj9, D-flat maj9(#11), B-flat m9, E-flat 9sus, two bars each), the violins' pizzicato double stops on the accents (giddy), over the keynote's own walk-on bed on the wall screen; the cheer gets no hit
THE STOP: his thumb sends the post (post_click 134.542): the eighths stop dead on the next eighth (the stop is the move, P03); the quartet holds its A-flat pedal under his post (dry) and V.O. 12
the call: the eighths back after V.O. 12, softer, cello and viola only (lonely, a little funny), the keynote's bed on the campus PA far off; his lines dry
"You ever miss being up there?": the eighths thin to the cello alone, no tick (weighted)
after "they let me hold the clicker." (on an eighth, 0.23 s before the cut): the eighths stop; the quartet holds its A-flat pedal (cello, viola) through F2.1
LAST UPDATED 2012: the band (E02-11c) is gone; the quartet's A-flat pedal alone (the pang)
the garden's push (on an eighth, 0.31 s before the cut): back from the memory, the quartet takes the garden-party arrangement (D-flat; the #11 its one wrong element; never a wedding march)
the garden, phrase 1 (the gate opens; the guest on its velvet rope): the first violin's tune, the viola's broken chords, the cello's pizzicato; the chip's square doubles its top note
phrase 2 (the raised hands, the nods, the text bubbles: the SFX's chip blips): the tune asks (the #11 held), then answers
phrase 3 (on an eighth, 0.31 s before the cut): the quartet thins to one violin (D-flat 5, sul tasto) under Radnus and "as a guest."
Radnus's smile holds a beat too long: the violin falls a semitone (D-flat to C: the pang begins)

the gate swings shut (on an eighth, 0.23 s before the cut): the violin's C hands down to the cello's C pedal (arco, sul tasto): the pang at the gate; the viola's C3 joins on the lock's turn (223.35); the pedal carries across the fold into sc 20 (L 0.6 s)
the split (on the beat, 0.04 s before the cut): the muted 808 returns under zAI's drone (on C, the pedal's root); the cello's C pedal; a sparse chip tick

DESIGNED HIT: Nole's lamp clicks on (the SFX's, 233.017) and his short fanfare (claimed nole_fanfare_short): the Launch's quartal stack C F B-flat E-flat on staccato trumpets, a chip burst, a timpani C; it falls off one note short of A-flat (OST §2.7), done before his post can be read
Nole's post (the record): dry: the C pedal and the 808, softer; no tick, no change
the padlock snaps on his own phone: THE 808 DROPS OUT (its last thud 245.208): the stop is the move, his own; the buzzing inside the cage gets nothing (the laugh is the picture's)

the lobby's morning (on the beat, 0.33 s before the cut): the C pedal resolves to F (the quartet's pedal: F3 C4 G4 C5, sul tasto, nothing below C3 under the lobby's hum); V.O. 13 and the docket play inside it, no change
the complaint has risen out of frame; the sticky note flutters down (sticky_flutter, the lock's): the quartet's pedal lifts; the quartet ends
DESIGNED HIT: the (FOR NOW) note lands on the clean rectangle: the cello's last pizzicato, C3 (the dominant, left open: for now). E02-11 ends; room tone only from here (the designed silence)
